title: Original Game Settings: Metric, Ecosystem Collision, Sound Configuration
summary: Settings → Game Settings ports the original Options → Game Settings page, restoring Measurement, Ecosystem Collision, and Sound Configuration options from the exact PS2 build.
details:
Measurement: Standard (U.S. system) or Metric. The game keeps one speed factor (0.68182 Mph or 1.08 Kph); Metric shows the speedometer in Kph and every jump record in Meters.

Ecosystem Collision On/Off: Off lets quads and riders ride through vegetation, stops race records (Freestyle records still count), and stays on in multiplayer. Turning it off shows the original Warning text with Yes/No.

Sound Configuration: Stereo, Stereo (Swapped), Dolby, Mono; Swapped and Mono apply to the mixed game audio; Dolby plays as Stereo.

Additional: King of the Hills hill bases and flags confirmed non-solid like the original (no collision mesh ships). Unit tests in atv-core/atv-ui/atv-game; browser test test_engine_game_settings.mjs covers warning No/Yes, Kph speedometer, vegetation skipped, Mono mixer, and persistence over reload. Settings, menu flows, menu parity and profile menu tests pass on host Chromium. PRs #355 and #356.
limitation: Device-wide setting (original stores Measurement in the profile); web soundtrack element not affected by Swapped/Mono; motorcycles keep vegetation collision; Split Screen and Display Mode rows have no counterpart.
